# CASE py_honest expect=pass
async def in_order(items, step, *, reason):
    for item in items:
        consume(await step(item))
# CASE py_distinct_plain expect=fire
async def in_order(items, step, *, reason):
    for item in items:
        consume(await step(item), await save(item))
# CASE py_distinct_fstring expect=fire
async def in_order(items, step, *, reason):
    for item in items:
        consume(await step(item), f"{await save(item)}")
# CASE py_distinct_fstring_spec expect=fire
async def in_order(items, step, *, reason):
    for item in items:
        consume(await step(item), f"{item:{await width(item)}}")
# CASE py_distinct_fstring_conv expect=fire
async def in_order(items, step, *, reason):
    for item in items:
        consume(await step(item), f"{await save(item)!r}")
# CASE py_distinct_fstring_debug expect=fire
async def in_order(items, step, *, reason):
    for item in items:
        consume(await step(item), f"{await save(item)=}")
# CASE py_distinct_nested_fstring expect=fire
async def in_order(items, step, *, reason):
    for item in items:
        consume(await step(item), f"{f'{await save(item)}'}")
# CASE py_distinct_triple_fstring expect=fire
async def in_order(items, step, *, reason):
    for item in items:
        consume(await step(item), f"""{await save(item)}""")
# CASE py_distinct_conditional expect=fire
async def in_order(items, step, *, reason):
    for item in items:
        consume(await step(item) if item else await save(item))
# CASE py_distinct_walrus expect=fire
async def in_order(items, step, *, reason):
    for item in items:
        consume(await step(item), (saved := await save(item)))
# CASE py_distinct_async_comprehension expect=fire
async def in_order(items, step, *, reason):
    for item in items:
        consume(await step(item), [row async for row in stream(item)])
# CASE py_distinct_await_comprehension expect=fire
async def in_order(items, step, *, reason):
    for item in items:
        consume(await step(item), [await save(row) for row in item.rows])
# CASE py_distinct_keyword expect=fire
async def in_order(items, step, *, reason):
    for item in items:
        consume(await step(item), await step(item=item))
# CASE py_steps_distinct_fstring expect=fire
async def in_order_steps(steps, *, reason):
    for step in steps:
        consume(await step(), f"{await audit()}")
